title: Jesus Do Tuhan
chord: Eb · G · Am · F · C · G · F · Eb
lyrics:
Jesus do Tuhanku Sihophop au on
Ibana do haposanki
TanganNa na gogo manogu au on
Patogu au di langkangki
Tuhanku tongtong sumarihon au on
Martua sonang tondingkon

Holong ni rohaNa pahisar au on
Mardame tongtong rohangkon
Mardame tongtong rohangkon
Jesus do Tuhan Siramoti au on
Na margogoihon diringkon
Nang gok parungkilon, godang na tinaon

Sabam do dibaen rohangkon
Tuhanku tongtong sumarihon au on
Martua sonang tondingkon
Holong ni rohaNa pahisar au on
Mardame tongtong rohangkon
Mardame tongtong rohangkon

Ndang montok asi ni rohaNa di au
Digohi TondiNa do au
Tama pujionku na marmudu au
Tuhanku Sipalua au
Tuhanku tongtong sumarihon au on
Martua sonang tondingkon

Holong ni rohaNa pahisar au on
Mardame tongtong rohangkon
